text: Get feature flags and experiments running in your app with a few lines of code using a language-specific SDK
quote: Get GrowthBook feature flags and experiments running in your app in a few lines of code, then pick a language-specific SDK.

text: Add attribute-based targeting conditions to a rule to control which value a user sees
quote: Add targeting conditions to a rule to control which values a user sees. Conditions are evaluated against attributes you pass into the SDK

text: Manage separate dev/staging/production environments with independently enabled/disabled flags
quote: Use environments such as dev, staging, and production to enable or disable feature flags independently.

text: Automatically detects unused/stale flags so they can be cleaned up from code
quote: GrowthBook can automatically detect these flags so you can clean them up.

text: Draft feature revisions, request review, resolve merge conflicts, and require approval before publishing changes
quote: Draft feature revisions, request review, resolve merge conflicts, and require approval before publishing.

text: Choose between a Bayesian or Frequentist statistics engine when viewing experiment results
quote: What you will see will depend a little bit on whether you are using our Bayesian or our Frequentist engine

text: Define Fact Tables and metrics so results are computed directly from your own data warehouse
quote: Define Fact Tables and metrics so GrowthBook can compute experiment results from your warehouse.

text: Self-host the full platform (MongoDB, API, front-end) via Docker Compose on your own infrastructure
quote: Run GrowthBook on your own infrastructure with Docker Compose, including MongoDB, the API, and the front-end.

text: Run a GrowthBook Proxy next to your app to cache SDK payloads, cut latency, and keep serving flags if the API is unreachable
quote: Run the GrowthBook Proxy next to your app to cache SDK payloads, reduce latency, and keep serving flags if the API is down.

text: Offers a full REST API for interacting with the application
quote: GrowthBook offers a full REST API for interacting with the application.

text: Official MCP server connects AI tools like Cursor, VS Code, and Claude to GrowthBook
quote: Connect AI tools like Cursor, VS Code, and Claude to GrowthBook using the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

text: Evaluate feature flags and Visual Editor experiments at the edge on Cloudflare Workers to reduce flicker
quote: Evaluate GrowthBook feature flags and Visual Editor experiments at the edge on Cloudflare Workers to cut flicker before HTML ships.

text: Starter tier adds visual editor, multi-arm bandits, safe rollouts, custom dashboards, advanced permissioning, and a power calculator
quote: Starter, plus: Visual editor Multi-arm bandits Safe rollouts Customizable dashboards Advanced permissioning Power calculator Premium support

text: Pro tier adds custom environments, ramp schedules, approval workflows, advanced access control, SSO/SCIM, and exportable audit logs
quote: Pro, plus: Custom environments Ramp schedules Approval workflows Advanced access control SSO & SCIM provisioning Exportable audit logs

text: Ships 24 official SDKs covering languages/platforms including React, Python, Android, and iOS
quote: 24 SDKs including React, Python, Android, and iOS.

text: Stats engine supports CUPED, sequential testing, Bayesian, post-stratification, bandits, and SRM checks
quote: World class experiment stats engine (CUPED, Sequential, Bayesian, Post-Strat, Bandits, SRM checks).

text: Warehouse-native: can query 11 data sources including BigQuery, Snowflake, and Databricks
quote: Warehouse Native. Query 11 data sources including BigQuery, Snowflake, and Databricks.

text: Includes a built-in product analytics suite to build and share dashboards
quote: Built-in Product Analytics suite to build dashboards and share with your team.

text: SDK hooks (e.g. useFeatureIsOn, useFeatureValue) serve boolean or typed dynamic config values, not just booleans
quote: const showNewFeature = useFeatureIsOn("new-feature"); const buttonColor = useFeatureValue("button-color", "blue");

text: Actual targeting attribute values (user IDs, emails) are never sent to GrowthBook, only kept in memory locally in the SDK
quote: The actual values of targeting attributes (e.g., user IDs, emails) are never sent to GrowthBook. They are only stored in memory locally within the SDK.

text: Run server-side experiments via inline SDK calls with no third-party network requests
quote: You can also run server-side experiments by using inline experiments directly with our SDK. This requires no 3rd party requests

text: SDK Connection Endpoint provides readonly, scoped access to just the flag data needed for evaluation
quote: The SDK Connection Endpoint provides readonly access to a subset of your feature flag data, just enough for the GrowthBook SDKs to assign values to users.

text: MCP server loads GrowthBook Agent Skills (workflows/guardrails) and makes authenticated calls to the REST API on an agent's behalf
quote: The official GrowthBook MCP server is a thin bridge: it loads GrowthBook Agent Skills (workflows and guardrails) and makes authenticated calls to the GrowthBook REST API.

text: Rules overriding a flag's default value can be scoped, ramped, and scheduled for gradual rollout or experimentation
quote: How rules override a feature's default value — targeting users, rolling out gradually, experimenting — and how to scope, ramp, and schedule them.

text: "Chance to Win" metric shows the probability a variation is better, highlighting clear winners above 95%
quote: Chance to Win" tells you the probability that the variation is better. Anything above 95%

text: Supports multiple experiment assignment methods: feature flags, URL redirects, the Visual Editor, or custom bucketing systems
quote: GrowthBook supports several ways to do this: Feature Flags (most common)... URL Redirects... Our Visual Editor... Your own custom variation assignment / bucketing system

text: Plans include unlimited feature flags, unlimited experiments, and unlimited traffic
quote:
Unlimited feature flags
*   Unlimited experiments
*   Unlimited traffic

text: Experiment rules randomly assign users to variations using a consistent hashing attribute
quote: you can add an experiment rule to a feature that will randomly assign the users based on some hashing attribute into one of your experiment variations.

text: Quickstart via 'docker compose up -d' to run the entire app locally in one command
quote: You can use docker compose to get started quickly... run docker compose up -d to start everything and view the app at http://localhost:3000

text: On app load, the SDK checks whether the user should be in an experiment and serves the assigned variation client-side
quote: When the client loads your application, our SDK will check to see if the user should be part of any experiments, and if so, assign them and the client code will serve that variations treatment to them.

text: Free plan supports up to 3 users, 1 project, and unlimited flags/experiments/traffic
quote:
Up to 3 users
*   1 project
*   Unlimited feature flags
*   Unlimited experiments
*   Unlimited traffic
